title: Director of Continuous Improvement
text:
**Role Description**
The Director of Continuous Improvement is a full-time remote role responsible for leading enterprise-wide initiatives that enhance processes, performance, and overall operational effectiveness. This role oversees the design, implementation, and governance of continuous improvement frameworks, partnering with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities, set priorities, and execute improvement roadmaps. Day-to-day activities include analyzing operational data, facilitating workshops, mapping and redesigning processes, and mentoring teams in continuous improvement methodologies. The Director will establish metrics, track progress against key performance indicators, and ensure that improvements are sustained through standardized practices and change management. This role also involves communicating findings and recommendations to senior leadership, aligning initiatives with strategic goals, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in Business Process Improvement and Process Improvement, with a track record of designing, implementing, and sustaining high-impact initiatives.
* Proven experience in Operational Excellence, including the use of frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) to improve quality, efficiency, and consistency.
* Advanced Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret complex data, develop insights, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated capability in Operations Management, including cross-functional collaboration and oversight of end-to-end processes.
* Experience leading change in remote or distributed teams, with strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Background in developing and tracking performance metrics, dashboards, and continuous improvement KPIs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt) are beneficial.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, and maintain a strategic, outcome-focused mindset.
